avoid_when: Avoid when the topic has no supporting visual or screenshot.
Avoid for dense data, multi-step processes, or more than two parallel content areas.
description: A formal academic content slide pairs concise explanatory text with a large supporting visual in a balanced two-column layout.
name: content-split
selection_hints: Use for explaining a topic with text on the left and one supporting visual on the right.
Works well for definitions, principles, features, or instructional commentary with a screenshot.
